title: Haze: is a 12 s fight limited by magazine and reload rather than fire rate?
question: Section I gun economy: with Titanic + Active Reload (55 rounds) at ~13-15 shots/s the magazine lasts ~4 s and reload is 2.35 s. Does Burst Fire add damage in a scripted 12 s fight with real reloads, compared with its +32% fire-rate headline?
hypothesis: Model: Burst Fire adds 0 damage in a 10 s window and ~+25% in 12 s (depends on whether a third magazine starts); sustained value about half of the fire-rate headline. Prediction: Burst Fire's damage gain over 12 s is < 20%.
controls: hardreset between blocks (fresh pawns, factory cooldowns/charges, unlock 7 = all 3 tiers on every ability in BOTH arms)
Same position (fetch 350, aimoff 5.5 3), same enemy bot (Haze), egod default floor
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B (counterbalanced A,B,B,A for the second half)
healreset + mark none around every reset
cast reload 2.5 before each fire block (no auto-reload op)
identical timeline: fire until empty (fire 6 caps it), cast reload 2.35, repeat until 12 s elapsed; log shots per block
procedure: give; cast reload 2.5; mark <arm>; fire 6; cast reload 2.35; fire 6 (truncate total to 12 s); acclog

decision.rule: If Burst Fire gains < 20%, the build is ammo-bound: magazine/refill items (Titanic, Lucky Shot clip, Vampiric Burst refill) are worth more than further fire rate; feeds the Healing Tempo vs Burst Fire comparison.

limitations: Checkpoint level/ability-tier states cannot be reproduced (unlock sets all tiers; GAPS #2): results are late-game relative comparisons only.
Active Reload timed press cannot be scripted (GAPS #15): Active Reload arms use the full 2.35 s reload.
